IC1: 1. Diagnosis of primary immunodeficiency [OR] with established plan to undergo myeloablative or non-myeloablative allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant [OR] for treatment thereof or diagnosis of a form of primary immunodeficiency [AND] for which [NOT] hematopoietic stem cell transplantation is not indicated.
IC2: 2. Active infection with EBV [OR], CMV [OR], and/or Adenovirus [AND], unable to be successfully controlled with standard therapy.
IC6: 6. Bilirubin <2x, AST <3x, Serum creatinine <2x upper limit of normal, Hgb >8.0
IC7: 7. Pulse oximetry of > 90% on room air
IC8: 8. Negative pregnancy test [AND] (if female of childbearing potential)
IC9: 9. Patient or parent/guardian capable of providing informed consent.
